hints.title: Grid Cut Decomposition
hints.text: A piece of wood of height h and width w can either be sold whole or cut into two pieces horizontally or vertically.

hints.title: Symmetric Cut Half-Range
hints.text: To cut horizontally, split into heights i and h - i for i up to h // 2. To cut vertically, split into widths j and w - j for j up to w // 2.

hints.title: 2D Optimal Substructure
hints.text: dp[h][w] is max(direct_price, max horizontal cuts, max vertical cuts).

hints.title: 2D Cutting DP Implementation

complexity.notes: With m, n <= 200, m * n * (m + n) is roughly 200^3 / 2 = 8 * 10^6 operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive decomposition without memoization visits overlapping subproblems exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D table of size (m + 1) x (n + 1) caches subproblem profits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate cuts up to h // 2 and w // 2 to exploit symmetry and halve cut evaluations.
